svg.text: Grm1 RNA in each of the twelve mice
Frozen Seurat populations · raw counts and per-nucleus normalization · descriptive, not DESeq2
Blue: six WT · rust: six cKO. Shared y scale. Raw counts are printed below each mouse; sample/library sizes differ.
Nuclear gene UMIs include unprocessed and shared RNA and cannot be read as mature isoform or membrane receptor abundance.
